outcome: maternal complications (post-operative fever, surgical site infection)
fetal outcomes (term births, healthy birth weights)
cohort: A total of 320 antenatal patients admitted to the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department of a tertiary care hospital in Central India were included.
finding: The study revealed a CS rate of 36.35%, exceeding the WHO's recommended threshold, with cephalopelvic disproportion, eclampsia, and fetal distress being common indications, and maternal complications occurring in 18.09% of cases.
mod_finding: The study found a CS rate of 36.35% and identified cephalopelvic disproportion, eclampsia, and fetal distress as common indications for caesarean section.
